## Mandates
- [M:42dae24e] **Quality Checks**: Use dt for all quality checks, including frontend vitest. Never run raw pytest, Vitest, Biome, TSC, Ruff, SQLFluff, or Squawk.
- [M:115b32e3] **Memory First**: Use st memory search before blind retries or spelunking. Use st search for live repo or code questions.
- [M:8b852e7f] Concurrent git activity is normal
- [M:c56547fe] Keep going to done
- [M:a74a469f] Commit before destroy
- [M:1bd49e94] Preview then confirm destroy
- [M:5c64b590] Use st search first in repos
- [M:0f074239] Credentials and secrets handling
- [M:4eef6e4a] Never commit secrets or private infra
- [M:eceb0575] Keep signal, cut filler
- [M:a8f39f9f] Dependency install fallback
- [M:6a2ceb1c] No speculative safety layers
- [M:4a864451] no pre-existing dismissals
- [M:d0cae92d] Citation: cite mandates/guardrails/references
- [M:a0f94be3] db CLI commands
- [M:b364ce4d] dt CLI commands
- [M:0fe5878c] Delete stale tests, don't update
- [M:c37d31f2] search before create
- [M:fbe46ad9] 1-3-1 Decision Gate
- [M:a20d9cc7] allow uncertainty
- [M:623cffe3] no access bypasses
- [M:c8406e6d] encourage disagreement
- [M:c918f298] prove it works
